name: TradeExpert
subtitle: Multi-Agent Stock Analysis Assistant
bullets: Developed a multi-agent stock analysis assistant in Python using Google ADK, supporting Gemini, Ollama, and LM Studio models.
Built AI-powered workflows for stock screening, company research, financial analysis, and market trend evaluation.

name: AI-Text-Assistant
subtitle: Privacy-First Local AI Assistant
bullets: Built a privacy-first AI text assistant using React, Node.js, and Ollama for fully local LLM inference with no external API calls.
Implemented text enhancement features including summarization, rewriting, grammar correction, and content generation.

name: Homelab Infrastructure Setup
bullets: Built and maintained a Proxmox-based homelab with Docker and Linux containers.
Deployed self-hosted apps (AdGuardHome, Traefik, n8n, Portainer) with reverse proxy and SSL.
Designed private subnet architecture with NAT, DHCP, DNS filtering, port forwarding, and LAN segmentation.
